endpoints.name: Create Nature Of Complaint

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

endpoints.detailed_description: Create nature of complaint. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, INatureOfComplaintRepository.IsNatureOfComplaintDuplicateAsync, INatureOfComplaintRepository.CreateNatureOfComplaintAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: NatureOfComplaint: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Nature of complaint name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.name)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: Nature of complaint with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]

ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet
